text: Ibrahim's half marathon is Sunday 12 October, his first one. He's raising money for the hospice that looked after his grandad, nearly at £900 already. His wife and their two boys are coming to cheer at mile 10 with a banner. He's worried about his calf, pulled it a few weeks ago. Remind me to text him good luck on Saturday night.
jin flying to seoul tmrw, 13hr flight, dreading it. back 2nd nov
Moira says her grandson Oliver got into the county youth orchestra, plays cello. She's over the moon.
Chatted to Siddharth after five a side. He's mad on Leeds United, has had a season ticket since he was a kid. Also into chess, plays online most nights.
Hadiza's play opens next Thursday at the Playhouse, she's got the lead. Need to book tickets before the weekend.

so Paolo and his wife are doing three weeks in Japan in April, Tokyo then Kyoto then Osaka, he's been learning Japanese on Duolingo for like a year for it. Their kids are staying with her parents. He did say the flight's the bit he's worried about, he hates flying, last long haul he didn't sleep at all
Jun's band gig cancelled, venue flooded. Rescheduled for 21/11 apparently.
Angela - knits. Like seriously, she's doing a jumper for every grandchild before Christmas. Seven of them.
Laura's dad passed his driving test at 64!! Third attempt. Should send her a card for him.
Joseph off to Lisbon this weekend for his brother's stag. Ask him Monday how it went

Henrik is a big Formula 1 guy, Ferrari fan since the Schumacher days, goes to Silverstone every July with his brother Lukas and camps for the whole weekend. Also does sim racing at home, has a proper rig with pedals in the spare room. Mentioned he'd love the new Lewis Hamilton book, good shout for his birthday 3rd of December.
Saskia's daughter Freya has her grade 5 piano exam on 14/11. Saskia more nervous than Freya is lol
pick up passport from post office friday, renew EHIC thing before Spain
Cem. Running the Berlin marathon next year, already training six days a week. Knee's playing up though, physio Tuesday.
Isaac and Keisha back from honeymoon in Bali, they loved it. Keisha got bitten by something and her ankle swelled up, think she's fine now.
Remember to ask Anan how the cup final went on Saturday, his son's team made it all the way. If they won, send congrats.
Jorge is into restoring old motorbikes, has a 1972 Triumph in his garage he's been doing up for two years.

Caroline told me today her mum's moving to Portugal for good in January. She's gutted but trying to be positive about it. Her mum's already found a flat in Faro. Caroline says she'll fly out for Easter and probably again in the summer. Don't forget to check in with her next week, she seemed quite low about it.
Ayo: obsessed w/ Warhammer, paints minis at weekends, has a whole cabinet. Hates football.
Sophie's netball team in the regional final 8th of November. She's captain. Text her the day before
Dafydd's choir competing at the Eisteddfod in August. Welsh male voice choir, tenor. Wants to win this time, came second last year.
Rin flies to Osaka tomorrow to see her grandparents, first time back in four years. Back on the 30th.
dentist 3rd of june 9:15. take car in for MOT same day if poss
Bilal says his sister Shreya is running the London Marathon in April for a cancer charity. Remind me to sponsor her, he's sending the link.
Svetlana — speedcubing. Her best is 11 seconds. Going to a competition in Manchester in a fortnight.
Okay so Lukas called, the Iceland trip is off, his partner broke her wrist skiing, so they've cancelled. Gutted for them. She's in a cast for six weeks. I should send her something, maybe flowers.
Matilda's cat Pepper went missing on Monday, still not back. She's put posters up everywhere. Check in with her tomorrow
Kerry going to see Taylor Swift in Edinburgh 7 June, got tickets in the ballot, absolutely buzzing
Ibrahim reckons Arsenal will win the league. He's had a season ticket since 2005 and goes to every home game with his dad.
Jin's daughter has her first ballet show on Saturday, 2pm. Jin's filming it for the grandparents in Busan. Ask her for the video next week.
Note to self, Moira (Mo) is doing the Camino in May, the whole 800km, she's 67. Her husband's not going, he's got a bad back. Should ask her if she wants to borrow my walking poles.
Oliver and Siddharth have the pub quiz final next Wednesday. Siddharth's the music round guy, knows every 80s b-side.
hadiza's interview went ok she thinks, hears back fri. also her mum's 70th is 19th oct, big do in birmingham
Paolo says the Rossi family reunion in Sicily is on for August, 40 relatives. His uncle is organising it. Paolo's dreading the heat but excited.
Just booked my own flights to Cape Town for 4 Feb, back 18 Feb. Need to sort travel insurance this weekend.
Jun just got into the Hackney Half ballot! Race is 18 May. He's never run more than 10k so a bit terrified.
Angela's husband retiring end of the month, they're planning a cruise round the Norwegian fjords in spring.
chat w Laura - into bouldering now, goes 3x a week, wants own shoes (size 6). gift idea?
Joseph Dubois is doing a ceramics course on Thursday evenings, made his first wonky mug. Really proud of it.
Henrik's lot are playing the cup semi this Sunday at 11. He's in goal. I'm going to watch, taking the kids.
Saskia and her husband are off to New Zealand for a month on the 2nd of January. Flight's 26 hours via Singapore. Their dog Biscuit going to her sister's.

Cem had his physio appointment yesterday, it's a tear in the meniscus apparently. Might need surgery, which would rule out Berlin. He's properly down about it, he's been training since March and already paid for the hotel. His girlfriend Kerry is trying to keep him positive. Remind me to ring him after his scan next Friday.
Isaac's doing a 1000 piece jigsaw of the Sistine Chapel ceiling. Been on it since August. Says it's the hardest thing he's ever done.
Keisha's brother Ayo is in a comedy show at the Fringe in August, his first solo hour. She's going up for the opening night. Must remember to get tickets for the 14th.
Anan supports Liverpool, collects old matchday programmes, has hundreds. Mentioned a 1977 European Cup final one would be his holy grail. Christmas present idea if I ever see one.

Jorge's daughter's graduation is 10th July in Glasgow, the whole family's going up. He's driving up the day before with the dog, his wife's flying with her mum because she can't do eight hours in a car with her hip. Daughter's got a first in marine biology and already has a job lined up in Aberdeen starting September. He's very proud.
Grand prix tickets came through. Silverstone, 5 July. Me and Dad.
Caroline's book club is doing War and Peace, they've given themselves till March lol. She's on chapter 12 and hates it.
Freya passed her grade 5!! Distinction. Saskia sent me a video of her playing. Send Freya a congrats message tonight

Sophie and Dafydd went to Lapland last week with the kids, saw the northern lights on the last night. Sophie said the reindeer sleigh thing was a bit of a rip-off though, and the flight back from Rovaniemi was delayed six hours. Their youngest, Matilda, threw up on the plane. They're already talking about going back to Norway next winter instead.
Rin's back from Japan. Said her grandma's not well, early dementia, didn't recognise her at first. She was really upset about it. I need to take her out for coffee this week.

Um so Bilal rang, his darts team won the league on Friday, he hit a 180 in the final leg which he will not stop talking about. He's been playing since uni. The presentation night is the 6th of December at the Red Lion and he's asked if I want to come along, partners welcome. Their next season starts in January.
Svetlana won her age group at the cubing comp! Off to the nationals in Bristol on 28/03 now.
Lukas Fischer, Bayern Munich fan, moved here from Munich in 2019, works at the hospital as a radiographer. Plays bass in a covers band on Saturday nights.
Matilda's cat's back!! Turned up in a neighbour's shed on Thursday, a bit thin but fine.

Shreya's wedding was supposed to be in Goa in March but it's been called off, she and her fiancé split up. She's taking it hard, going to stay with her parents in Leicester for a bit. Dont mention it at work. Remind me to message her on Sunday just to see how she's doing.
Kerry's son is in the school production of Oliver! next Tuesday and Wednesday, he's the Artful Dodger. She's been sewing his costume all week.
Laura and her partner off to Mexico tomorrow for two weeks, then a week in Cuba. She's been planning it since last year. Ask her how Havana was when she's back on the 3rd.

Ibrahim's daughter Hadiza has her violin recital on 22 November, Grade 8. He said she's been practising four hours a day and is a nervous wreck. Wish her luck the night before. He also said he's training for a triathlon in the spring, open water swimming every Saturday morning at the lake.
Gym at 7 tomorrow then food shop. Tuesday sort the boiler service.
